{{Quote|Those fools who failed were told they would be dealing with one Jedi and her Padawan. Not two. Jedi strength multiplies exponentially. Fighting one is like fighting two. Dealing with two more akin to trying to handle eight.|Soergg, to his majordomo, Ogomoor|<ref name="The Approaching Storm" />}}
In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], a '''skirmish''' took place at an [[Unidentified Cuipernam Inn|inn]] located in the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ansion/Legends|Ansion's]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Cuipernam]] during a [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi]]-led [[Diplomat/Legends|diplomatic]] [[Border dispute on Ansion/Legends|mission]] to the world. The skirmish began when [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Luminara Unduli/Legends|Luminara Unduli]] and her [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]], [[Barriss Offee/Legends|Barriss Offee]], were attacked by [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]] sent by [[Soergg Vosadii Bezhin|Soergg]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]], who was a self-titled [[bossban]] and a participant in [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Dooku/Legends|Darth Tyranus]] and [[Commerce Guild/Legends|Commerce Guild]] [[Presidente]] [[Shu Mai/Legends|Shu Mai's]] plot to have Ansion secede from the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. The two [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] were saved by the timely appearance of [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and his Padawan, [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], who had arrived on Ansion two [[Standard day/Legends|days]] earlier than their scheduled arrival.<ref name="The Approaching Storm" />

==Prelude==
{{Quote|If we can get the Ansionians to commit to pulling out of the Republic, no one will really care. But because of their alliances, their withdrawal should be enough to sway their already vacillating partners in both the Malarian Alliance and the Keitumite Treaty to follow.|Shu Mai, Presidente of the Commerce Guild|<ref name="The Approaching Storm" />}}
During the growing [[Separatist Crisis/Legends|Separatist Crisis]] in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], in which many [[Star system/Legends|star systems]] seceded from the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] to form the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ansion/Legends|Ansion]] became a target in a plot led by [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Dooku/Legends|Darth Tyranus]] and [[Commerce Guild/Legends|Commerce Guild]] [[Presidente]] [[Shu Mai/Legends|Shu Mai]]. Ansion lay at the heart of several treaties, so the planet's secession from the Republic would in turn cause the secession of many other worlds. To prevent that, the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] dispatched [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Masters]] [[Luminara Unduli/Legends|Luminara Unduli]] and [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], with their respective [[Padawan/Legends|Padawans]], [[Barriss Offee/Legends|Barriss Offee]] and [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], on a [[Diplomat/Legends|diplomatic]] mission to convince the [[Unity of Community]], Ansion's government, to stay within the Republic.<ref name="The Approaching Storm" />

The Jedi hoped to negotiate an arrangement between the Unity of Community and the [[Alwari]], nomadic tribes of [[Ansionian]]s. The Unity agreed that if the Alwari would share dominion over the prairie lands that they currently controlled and allow the Unity to develop the resources that lay within half or more of those lands, then Ansion would remain in the Republic.<ref name="The Approaching Storm" />

Mai hired [[Bossban]] [[Soergg Vosadii Bezhin|Soergg]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] to ensure Ansion's secession. Soergg had his [[Majordomo/Legends|majordomo]] [[Ogomoor]], in turn, hire [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]] to stop the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] before they could leave [[Cuipernam]], the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]] of Ansion, in search of the Alwari [[overclan]]s (nomadic leaders). The Hutt-dispatched mercenaries were warned that they would be dealing with Jedi.<ref name="The Approaching Storm" />

==The skirmish==
{{Quote|Master Luminara, there are too many!|Barris Offee|<ref name="The Approaching Storm" />}}
While Unduli and Offee were eating at an [[Unidentified Cuipernam Inn|inn]] in Cuipernam, Unduli [[Force sense/Legends|sensed]] that something was not right. She ignited her [[Luminara's lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]], with Offee igniting [[Barriss Offee's lightsaber/Legends|her own]] a moment later. At that point they were attacked by the local mercenaries hired by Ogomoor. The first wave swarmed in through doorways and [[Window/Legends|windows]] and out of various hiding places, wielding weapons ranging from [[Knife/Legends|blades]] to [[Blaster/Legends|blasters]]. The first wave was uncoordinated, and the Jedi easily dealt with them, deflecting blaster shots and [[Death/Legends|killing]] several mercenaries before fighting their way out of the tavern and into the street. As soon as they were on the verge of pushing the remaining mercenaries into an open area, the second wave appeared.<ref name="The Approaching Storm" />

The second wave of mercenaries acted more as a unit and began to push the Jedi back. To escape them, Unduli ordered her Padawan to climb up a nearby wall, though Kenobi and Skywalker appeared before Unduli could follow. Having arrived at Ansion two [[Standard day/Legends|days]] before they were expected, and not finding the other two Jedi at their stated residence, Obi-Wan and Anakin had gone for a walk to acquaint themselves with the city. It was then that Kenobi sensed trouble and, with his Padawan, came to Unduli's and Offee's rescue. They cut through the remaining mercenaries, killing several and forcing the rest to retreat.<ref name="The Approaching Storm" />

==Aftermath==
{{Quote|When you weren't at your stated residence, we decided to take a stroll to acquaint ourselves with the city. That's when I sensed the trouble. It drew us to you.|Obi-Wan Kenobi, to Unduli and Offee|<ref name="The Approaching Storm" />}}
Soergg was not pleased with the failure, blaming the mercenaries for not taking his warning about the Jedi seriously. He was also concerned that Kenobi and Skywalker had shown up two days early and thought it should be brought to the attention of other key participants in the plot, such as [[Ansionian]] [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Mousul]], who reported to Shu Mai. Shortly after, Soergg tasked [[Kyakhta]] and [[Bulgan]], two clanless and mentally injured Ansionians, with [[Kidnapping of Barriss Offee|kidnapping]] one of the Padawans, and they succeeded in capturing Offee. They chose to carry out the kidnapping while the Jedi were wandering through a [[Unidentified Cuipernam marketplace|marketplace]] in Cuipernam.<ref name="The Approaching Storm" />

==Behind the scenes==
The skirmish in Cuipernam first appeared in the [[2002]] novel ''[[The Approaching Storm]]'', written by [[Alan Dean Foster]].<ref name="The Approaching Storm" />
